title: ISW Paper Revision Patch: Proposed Corrections to ISW Cross-Correlation Predictions for EFC with DESI DR1 Tracers
abstract: This internal note issues a minimal correction patch to the previously published ISW cross-correlation predictions for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) with DESI DR1 tracers. It clarifies the growth-driven vs potential-driven channel interpretation, withdraws irreproducible redshift-dependent AISW values, and replaces them with a uniform AISW ≈ 0.89 ± 0.03 suppression across all bins, while retiring an inapplicable cancellation metric.
